articles.headline: Washington loses running backs Carr, Limar for extended time
articles.description: Washington's running back depth has taken a significant hit as starter Quaid Carr and backup Jayden Limar both will miss extended time with injuries sustained in Sunday's win against Washington State.

articles.headline: Kiffin calls on LSU fans to bring Week 1 energy vs. Louisiana Tech
articles.description: With Louisiana Tech coming to town after an 80-point performance, Kiffin praises the Bulldogs' offense and urges No. 11 LSU fans to recreate the atmosphere they brought against Clemson.

articles.headline: Silverfield confident Arkansas QB Jackson will rebound from Week 1
articles.description: After KJ Jackson lost a fumble and threw an interception in the win over North Alabama, Ryan Silverfield says the QB responds well to hard coaching and is focused on correcting his mistakes.

articles.headline: Sarkisian keeps CFP implications out of focus for Texas vs. Ohio State
articles.description: Ahead of the No. 5 Longhorns' highly anticipated matchup with No. 1 Ohio State, Sarkisian says his attention is solely on the Buckeyes and not what the result could mean for the CFP.
